in_marathi.name: Mahish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Mahish is the name of a demon in the form of a buffalo or a bull. He was slain by the goddess Durga in her form as Mahishasura Mardini.
